summary: Critical Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K disclosing an amendment to its binding Scheme Implementation Deed (dated May 18, 2026, as amended July 3, 2026) to acquire European Lithium Ltd. via two interdependent Australian schemes of arrangement. The August 19, 2026 amendment replaced the fixed exchange ratio of 0.035 Critical Metals shares per European Lithium share with a floating ratio with cap and collar: between US$8.00 and US$16.00 (20-day VWAP of Critical Metals on Nasdaq), the ratio adjusts straight-line from 0.045 to 0.025. Consideration for options and performance rights flows through. Material terms and conditions precedent remain unchanged. Watch for shareholder meetings and scheme approvals; risk-arb hinges on VWAP and regulatory clearances.
